tasks.title: Make Topic Tab glyphs compact and directly navigable
tasks.objective: Turn each Topic Tab glyph into a direct activation affordance for its existing Workbench location.
tasks.outcome: The rail is tighter, and clicking or keyboard-confirming a glyph activates that Tab without creating duplicate surfaces.
acceptance: Each rendered Tab glyph has a button-like activation path and invokes the existing workspace Tab/Region selection callback.
The rail uses compact chip and glyph dimensions while preserving a readable single-Region icon and multi-Region map.
Removing the activation callback or compact style contract makes the focused topology tests red, and the production panel remains connected.

verification.ref: pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/topic-agent-status.test.ts test/workspace-topics-panel.test.tsx --maxWorkers=1
verification.proves: Topic glyph markup, activation callback, and compact rail contract.
Navigation and styling changes compile cleanly.
The reusable topology is connected to a production activation path.

tasks.title: Use one clean Region-map hover inspector
tasks.objective: Show the selected Tab's actual Region distribution without repeating the same Regions as a second list.
tasks.outcome: The hover/focus surface is a concise map with real aspect ratios, icons, and minimal inline activity labels.
acceptance: The inspector map preserves each Region's x/y/width/height proportions from the Workbench layout.
The redundant activity list below the map is removed; each Region may carry only a compact in-map label or tooltip.
The inspector remains viewport-safe and keyboard discoverable.

verification.proves: Region-map geometry and non-redundant inspector markup.
The Region map remains connected to the reusable topology.

tasks.title: Left-align content inside right-docked human messages
tasks.objective: Keep user bubbles on the right while making their Markdown content read from the left edge.
tasks.outcome: Human message body content is left aligned without moving the bubble or changing Agent message layout.
acceptance: The human message body uses text-align: left while the human turn remains right docked.
The rule covers the shared Markdown body, including paragraphs, lists, tables, and code blocks through inheritance.
Removing the body alignment rule makes the focused conversation style test red.

verification.proves: Human message layout and Markdown alignment contract.
The shared human body style remains connected to ConversationMessage.
